Discounts are built on the branch `freeloader/discounts/main`, and the reviewer approved them. I did not merge, open a pull request or run cleanup.

- **Tasks:** both passed on free models, with no escalations. They were 001-discount-types (the three dataclasses) and 002-total-cents (`total_cents`).
- **Model:** `opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free` did all the work. It passed 2 of 2 attempts with no rate limits.
- **Files:** the change adds `shopkit/discounts.py`, `tests/test_discounts_types.py` and `tests/test_discounts_total.py`.
- **Tests:** the reviewer ran the suite on a clean checkout and all 81 tests passed, the 17 existing ones plus the new ones. It checked each rule in your request against the code and found no problems.
- **Choices beyond your spec:**
  - `discounts` can be any iterable, including a generator.
  - `total_cents` leaves the cart unchanged and returns an `int`.
  - Rounding uses whole-number arithmetic only, so it stays exact on very large amounts.
- **Not fixed:** `Cart.remove` in `shopkit/cart.py` (around line 20) can push a quantity below zero. A `FixedOff` minimum could then be checked against a wrong subtotal. I did not touch it, because it is outside this feature.

To take the work, you can either run `git merge freeloader/discounts/main`, or run `feature.sh pr discounts` to push the branch and open a PR. Once you've done either, run `feature.sh cleanup discounts`. Tell me which you want.
